svg.title: Key design decisions for blog platform
svg.desc: Shows JSONB structure for Post content, tsvector search setup, S3 media flow, and recursive comment tree.
svg.text: CREATE INDEX ON posts USING GIN(search_vector);
JOIN tree t ON c.parent_id = t.id

g.text: Relationship types used in this design

svg.text: Composition (Blog→Post, User→Profile): lifecycle tied, child cannot exist without parent
Aggregation (Post→MediaAsset, Post→Revision): child has independent existence
Recursive self-ref (Comment→Comment, Category→Category): parent_id FK on same table
Association / many-to-many (Post↔Tag via PostTag junction table)
